ops.statement: Arming a blocking watcher/monitor after launching a detached process is the most common kill pattern for multi-hour gold-pipeline runs: the session sleeps on the watcher and dies. Safe pattern: launch detached, record PID + expected output artifact in the state note, and check on resume — no watcher. Short foreground steps run foreground, no detach.
ops.grounding: .agent-work/453/ADMIRAL_LOG.md 2026-06-13 INCIDENT (third watcher-sleep death); cmdr-440.md STATE LOG (3 watcher-armed kills across continuations)

ops.statement: Never commit .agent-work/LESSONS.md, .agent-work/AGENT_FEEDBACK.md, or .agent-work/CONSTELLATION_FEEDBACK.md on a mission branch. Return lessons-delta.json and feedback entries in the closeout report; the Admiral applies them centrally. Merging a mission branch that writes these clobbers canonical state from siblings.
ops.grounding: .agent-work/453/ADMIRAL_LOG.md 2026-06-11 INCIDENT (LESSONS.md clobber on PR #457 merge; AGENT_FEEDBACK add/add conflict from concurrent #458)

ops.statement: Do not end your turn on a question whose answer is already in the launch order; re-read it before surfacing anything. A turn ending on a pre-answered question (or an intermediate spine step) is a discipline violation that forces an unnecessary continuation re-dispatch.
ops.grounding: .agent-work/453/ADMIRAL_LOG.md 2026-06-11 RULING (cmdr-410 premature float); INCIDENT (cmdr-425 workbench-init stall); RULING (cmdr-425 cont-1 filing question pre-answered in LO)

ops.statement: Issue close is a separate step sequenced strictly after the merge is CONFIRMED, not after gate checks pass. Sequence: verify checks green, merge, verify main HEAD advanced, then close. Never batch the close with gate verification.
ops.grounding: .agent-work/453/ADMIRAL_LOG.md 2026-06-11 ADMIRAL ERROR (closed #425 citing 'merged, checks green' while PR #466 gate had actually FAILED and the merge never ran)

ops.statement: Update the crash-resume state note (step done, slug, next command, process PID, expected output) BEFORE launching any detached multi-hour process. A stale note when the session dies needs forensics; a current note makes every recovery trivial.
ops.grounding: .agent-work/453/ADMIRAL_LOG.md 2026-06-13 INCIDENT (cont3 violated this, ~3h lost); cmdr-440.md (4 trivial recoveries when honored)

ops.statement: Any finding actionable for a downstream open issue must be posted as an issue comment AT DISCOVERY TIME. Session scratch (post-run notes, archive files) is invisible to the next fleet. Archiving a session must check: are there findings that belong on open issues?
ops.grounding: .agent-work/453/ADMIRAL_LOG.md 2026-06-12 ESCALATION (2026-06-10 stale-LOSO finding lived only in session scratch; cmdr-440 rediscovered it from scratch)
